caption: The drawing depicts a single, round bowl with a thick, slightly outward-curved rim. The bowl is colored in shades of brown and reddish-brown, with marbled and swirling patterns both inside and outside, suggesting a wood or ceramic texture. The rim is a pale bluish-green and bears black cursive writing, which includes the characters "S. O. S. 1867." The interior of the bowl also shows decorative patterns in similar hues. There is a small notch or chip visible on the rim at the top right. The bowl is set against a plain, off-white background, and there is a handwritten signature, "Grace Halpin," at the lower right corner outside the bowl.
title: Bowl
